description: A {role} pastes a generic pandas snippet that resamples half-hourly load data and asks for a review.
text:
Is there a cleaner way to do this? It resamples half-hourly load to daily peak and flags weekends.

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('load.csv', parse_dates=['ts']).set_index('ts')
daily = df['kw'].resample('D').max().to_frame('peak_kw')
daily['weekend'] = daily.index.dayofweek >= 5
print(daily.head())
